test_sort_values_basic: test DataFrame.sort_values to sort rows by a single column ascending or descending
test_sort_values_multicolumn: test DataFrame.sort_values to sort rows by multiple columns with independent ascending flags
test_sort_values_na_position: test DataFrame.sort_values to control na_position as first or last for NaN and NaT values
test_sort_values_stable: test DataFrame.sort_values with kind=mergesort to verify stable sort preserves original order for ties
test_sort_values_key_function: test DataFrame.sort_values with a key function to transform values before sorting
